title: 第十三章 第一口血
content_zh:
那把刀，是真的。

    江砚不敢信，又不能不信。它就攥在他手里，沉甸甸的，带着金属特有的冰凉，刃口贴着他的指腹，稍一用力，就割破了一点皮，渗出血珠来——疼是真疼。

    不是幻觉。不是错觉。是一把真真切切、能割人的铁刀。

    他顾不上多想，趁着这股震撼还没散，立刻调整姿势，把那把刀别扭地横过来，刀刃对准了勒着他手腕的麻绳。

    绑得太紧，刀又短，他反绑着的手腕几乎使不上劲。他只能凭着一点点感觉，一下一下地，用那道粗糙的刃，去蹭、去割那根粗麻绳。

    刃口磨过绳纤维的“嗤啦“声，在死寂的柴房里，轻得只有他自己听得见。

    一下。

    两下。

    绳子很韧，刀刃又毛糙，割得极慢。江砚的手腕被绳子勒了大半天，早没了知觉，他不知道自己有没有割到肉，只能凭着那点声音判断——绳子，在一根一根地断。

    汗，从他额头上沁出来，又被柴房的寒气一激，冰凉。

    “快……快断……“他在心里咬着牙催。

    外头那看守的家丁不知什么时候又踱了过来，懒洋洋地咳嗽了一声。江砚浑身一僵，停了手，大气不敢出。直到那脚步声又远了，他才重新动起来。

    不知割了多久，他只觉得手腕上那股勒着的力道，忽然一松——

    “啪。“

    绳子，断了。

    江砚的双手，自由了。

    他几乎是立刻把胳膊从背后扯到身前，那一下牵动了僵了太久的筋骨，疼得他闷哼出声。手腕上是一圈深紫的勒痕，被刀蹭破了几处，渗着血。可他顾不上。

    他攥着那把刀，急急地撑着墙要站起来——

    就在这时，毫无征兆地，眼前一黑。

    天旋地转。

    整间柴房，连同那点门缝里的微光，都在他眼前剧烈地旋转、模糊、变形。一股钻心的、从五脏六腑深处涌上来的虚弱，像决了堤的水，瞬间淹没了他。
content_en:
That knife is real.

    Jiang Yan couldn't believe it, but he couldn't help but believe it. It was clenched in his hand, heavy, with the unique coldness of metal, and the blade was pressed against his fingertips. With a little force, it cut a little of the skin and oozed blood - it really hurt.

    Not an illusion. It's not an illusion. It is a real iron knife that can cut people.

    He didn't think too much, and before the shock dissipated, he immediately adjusted his posture, turned the knife awkwardly sideways, and aimed the blade at the hemp rope strangling his wrist.

    The binding was too tight and the knife was short. His wrists, which were tied behind his back, could hardly exert any strength. He could only use a little feeling to rub and cut the thick hemp rope with the rough blade step by step.

    The sound of the blade grinding against the rope fibers was so soft that only he could hear it in the dead silence of the woodshed.

    one time.

    Two times.

    The rope was very tough and the blade was rough, so it cut very slowly. Jiang Yan's wrist was strangled by the rope for a long time, and he had long lost consciousness. He didn't know if he had cut any flesh. He could only judge by the sound - the rope was breaking one by one.

    Sweat broke out from his forehead, and was stirred by the cold air in the woodshed, making it cold.

    "Quickly...quickly break..." He gritted his teeth in his heart and urged.

    The servant guarding outside walked over again at some point and coughed lazily. Jiang Yan froze, stopped his hand, and did not dare to express his anger. It wasn't until the footsteps were far away that he started moving again.

    He didn't know how long he had been cutting, but he felt the tight force on his wrist suddenly loosened——

    "Crack."

    The rope is broken.

    Jiang Yan's hands were free.

    He almost immediately pulled his arm from behind to in front of him, which stretched the muscles and bones that had been stiff for too long, making him groan in pain. There was a circle of deep purple marks on the wrist, which had been scratched in several places by the knife and was oozing with blood. But he couldn't care less.

    He clutched the knife and hurriedly supported the wall to stand up——

    At this moment, without warning, everything went dark.

    The world is spinning.

    The entire woodshed, including the glimmer of light in the crack of the door, was violently spinning, blurring, and deforming before his eyes. A heart-wrenching weakness surged up from deep within his organs, like water bursting a bank, instantly drowning him.
